description_en: Calls the ModifyTunnelAttribute operation to modify the tunnel configuration of a high-availability VPN gateway
description_zh: 调用ModifyTunnelAttribute接口修改高可用VPN的隧道配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-tunnel-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-gw69vm1i71y3540000 --tunnel-id tun-gbyz2e070xzo930000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTunnelAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the customer gateway associated with the tunnel
fields.help_zh: 隧道关联的用户网关实例ID
fields.name: customer_gateway_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Dead Peer Detection (DPD) feature. Valid values:

true: enables DPD. The IPsec initiator sends DPD packets to check whether the peer is alive. If no correct response is received within the specified time, the connection is considered disconnected, and the ISAKMP SA, IPsec SA, and IPsec tunnel are deleted.

false: disables DPD. The IPsec initiator does not send DPD packets
fields.help_zh:
是否开启DPD（对等体存活检测）功能。取值：

true：开启DPD功能。隧道发起端会发送DPD报文用来检测对端的设备是否存活，如果在设定时间内未收到正确回应则认为对端已经断线，隧道将删除ISAKMP SA和相应的IPsec SA，隧道同样也会被删除。

false：不开启DPD功能，隧道发起端不会发送DPD探测报文
fields.name: enable_dpd

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable NAT traversal. Valid values:

true: enables NAT traversal. After NAT traversal is enabled, the IKE negotiation process skips UDP port number verification and can discover NAT gateway devices along the VPN tunnel.

false: disables NAT traversal
fields.help_zh:
是否开启NAT穿越功能。取值：

true：开启NAT穿越功能。开启后，IKE协商过程会删除对UDP端口号的验证过程，同时实现对VPN隧道中NAT网关设备的发现功能。

false：不开启NAT穿越功能
fields.name: enable_nat_traversal

fields.help_en: The peer CA certificate when the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a China Certification Authority (China CA) VPN gateway
fields.help_zh: 在国密型VPN网关下使用IPsec连接时，对端的CA证书
fields.name: remote_ca_certificate

fields.help_en: The autonomous system number (ASN) of the local end of the tunnel. Valid values: 1 to 4294967295
fields.help_zh: 隧道本端自治系统号。自治系统号取值范围：1~4294967295
fields.name: local_asn

fields.help_en: The BGP IP address of the local end of the tunnel. This address must be an IP address within the TunnelCidr range
fields.help_zh: 隧道本端的BGP IP地址。该地址需是TunnelCidr内的一个IP地址。
fields.name: local_bgp_ip

fields.help_en:
The CIDR block of the BGP IP address on the local end of the tunnel.

The CIDR block must be a CIDR block with a mask length of 30 within 169.254.0.0/16 and cannot be 169.254.0.0/30, 169.254.1.0/30, 169.254.2.0/30, 169.254.3.0/30, 169.254.4.0/30, 169.254.5.0/30, 169.254.6.0/30, or 169.254.169.252/30.

The IPsec tunnel CIDR block of each IPsec-VPN connection under a VPN gateway instance must be unique
fields.name: tunnel_cidr

fields.help_en:
The BGP configuration of the tunnel to modify.

If BGP was not previously enabled for the tunnel, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120381.html operation to enable BGP for the tunnel and add BGP configurations
fields.help_zh:
修改隧道的BGP配置。

如果隧道之前并未开启BGP功能，您需要调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120381.html接口为隧道开启BGP功能并添加BGP配置
fields.name: tunnel_bgp_config

fields.help_en:
The authentication algorithm in Phase 1 negotiation.

<props="china">

If the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a standard VPN gateway, valid values are: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, or sha512.
If the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a China CA VPN gateway, the value is: sm3.

</props>


<props="intl">

Valid values: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, or sha512.

</props>
fields.help_zh:
第一阶段协商的认证算法。

<props="china">

如果IPsec关联的是普通型VPN网关，则取值为：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384或sha512。
如果IPsec关联的是国密型VPN网关，则取值为：sm3。

</props>


<props="intl">

取值为：md5、sha1、sha256、sha384或sha512

</props>
fields.name: ike_auth_alg

fields.help_en:
The encryption algorithm in Phase 1 negotiation.

<props="china">

If the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a standard VPN gateway, valid values are: aes, aes192, aes256, des, or 3des.  
If the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a China CA VPN gateway, the value is: sm4.

</props>

<props="intl">

Valid values: aes, aes192, aes256, des, or 3des.  

</props>
fields.help_zh:
第一阶段协商的加密算法。

<props="china">

如果IPsec关联的是普通型VPN网关，则取值为：aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。  
如果IPsec关联的是国密型VPN网关，则取值为：sm4。

</props>

<props="intl">

取值为：aes、aes192、aes256、des或3des。  

</props>
fields.name: ike_enc_alg

fields.help_zh: 第一阶段协商出的SA的生存周期。单位：秒。取值范围：0~86400
fields.name: ike_lifetime

fields.help_en:
The negotiation mode of the IKE version. Valid values:

main: main mode. The negotiation process is more secure.
aggressive: aggressive mode. The negotiation is faster and has a higher success rate
fields.help_zh:
IKE版本的协商模式。取值：

main：主模式，协商过程安全性高。
aggressive：野蛮模式，协商快速且协商成功率高
fields.name: ike_mode

fields.help_zh: 第一阶段协商使用的Diffie-Hellman密钥交换算法。取值：group1、group2、group5、group14

fields.name: ike_version

fields.help_en: The identifier of the local end of the tunnel. The value can be up to 100 characters in length and cannot contain spaces. The value supports FQDN and IP formats. Default value: the IP address of the tunnel
fields.help_zh: 隧道本端的标识。长度限制为100个字符，，不能包含空格，支持FQDN和IP格式。默认值为隧道的IP地址
fields.name: local_id

fields.help_en:
The pre-shared key used for identity authentication between the tunnel and the peer.
    
The key must be 1 to 100 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and the following characters. It cannot contain spaces. ```~!`@#$%^&*()_-+={}[]|;:',.<>/?```
If you do not specify a pre-shared key, the system randomly generates a 16-character string as the pre-shared key. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120374.html operation to query the pre-shared key that is automatically generated by the system.
The pre-shared keys configured on the tunnel and the peer must be the same. Otherwise, the tunnel cannot be established
fields.help_zh:
预共享密钥，用于隧道及对端之间的身份认证。
    
密钥长度为1~100个字符，支持数字、大小写英文字母以及右侧字符，不能包含空格。```~!`@#$%^&*()_-+={}[]|;:',.<>/?```
若您未指定预共享密钥，系统会随机生成一个16位的字符串作为预共享密钥。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120374.html接口查询系统自动生成的预共享密钥。
隧道及隧道对端配置的预共享密钥必须一致，否则系统无法成功建立隧道
fields.name: psk

fields.help_en: The identifier of the peer end of the tunnel. The value can be up to 100 characters in length and cannot contain spaces. The value supports FQDN and IP formats. Default value: the IP address of the customer gateway instance associated with the tunnel
